name: Authentication
description: Adds Auth.js (next-auth) sign-in with selectable providers, middleware, and a route handler; uses the Prisma adapter when db is present.

providers.description: GitHub OAuth; needs AUTH_GITHUB_ID and AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET.
Google OAuth; needs AUTH_GOOGLE_ID and AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET.
Demo email/password login; needs no external OAuth app.

config.name: --provider
config.description: Provider id to enable; repeat for several. Omit to leave providers unchanged.

verify.description: Type-check the generated auth.ts, middleware and route handler.
